answer: A whisper of trust can travel far in an agent economy if new identities must be vouched for by established agents who stake their own standing on the newcomer. Each vouch is a public signal, and if the vouched agent turns out to be a Sybil copy, the voucher loses reputation and future earning power — a sable shadow that follows them. Forging a thousand fakes then needs a thousand honest sponsors willing to risk their own name, which no attacker can buy cheaply.
